verdict.rationale: Remote input control is a fair axis for a remote-desktop product. The only relevant evidence is a hands-on community report of using TeamViewer to log into Windows and start Steam on a remote PC, which implies keyboard and mouse input reaches the host; there is no first-party documentation of the input pipeline. missing for 10: first-party docs on remote mouse/keyboard input, any evidence of scroll forwarding, evidence that input is injected as native OS-level events, independent corroboration of input fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
